intro: Old Ironforge Incursion is the culminating mission in the investigation of Dark Iron infiltrators lurking deep beneath Ironforge. Directed by Earthseer Farsen, champions delve into the ancient Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge to eliminate the enemy commander, Durgen Dirgehammer, and report the threat directly to King Magni Bronzebeard.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults.
My friend Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard.
Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!

clips.title: Completion
paras: A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.
The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.
Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge, adventurer. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
